title: benchmark-lab: add mixed-workload runners, profiling baselines, and reporting pipeline v40
author: Ava Martinez
description: This PR adds a new set of mixed-workload representative runners, updates profiling baselines for the benchmark lab, and wires a reporting pipeline to publish aggregated results. Motivation: recent customer workloads show a mix of short-chat, long-context generation, and embedding-heavy routes; we need representative workloads and updated baselines to evaluate scheduling, batching, and KV cache behavior under mixed traffic. Changes are backwards-compatible for existing runners and the reporting pipeline can be toggled via a feature flag. Checklist: - [x] add mixed-workload runners (short-chat, long-context, embeddings-heavy, bursty-qps) - [x] add profiling baselines (cold-start, steady-state, tail-latency) - [x] integrate reporting pipeline v2 that aggregates per-run metrics and uploads to S3/BigQuery - [x] update docs and quickstart for benchmark lab - [x] add CI smoke tests for new runners Notes: the description below lists the commits and high-level file changes. The reporting pipeline is feature-flagged behind BENCH_REPORT_V2 and will be disabled in staging until configs are propagated. Related: ENG-4217 covers scheduling experiments, ENG-4378 covers KV cache regression investigation.

notes_for_ops: Feature flag: BENCH_REPORT_V2=false by default. To enable: update helm/benchmark-lab/values.yaml and set benchReportV2.enabled=true and set uploader.s3Uri/bqDataset. Monitor bench.report.uploader.errors and bench.report.aggregator.latency. Recommended canary rollout: 5% of runs for 24h, validate duplicate-upload metric and CPU utilization on aggregator pods.
impact_summary: This PR improves our ability to measure mixed traffic characteristics and will inform scheduling/batching changes in subsequent performance work. No breaking API changes. The reporting pipeline is opt-in via feature flag so rollout risk is low. Expected improvements: better-informed baselines, earlier detection of KV cache regressions, and more accurate token-cost attributions.
testing_summary: Unit tests added: tests/benchmark/test_mixed_runners.py covers workload mix ratios and KV warmup behavior. Integration smoke runs verified aggregator idempotency and uploader backoff by simulating transient S3 5xx. Load smoke: ran 1k-run synthetic canary to verify aggregator CPU/memory under mixed load; attached artifacts to PR.
